raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Give the score-centering loss tests a fresh `DistributedStatsTracker` for each test. Earlier tests can leave `n_valid_tokens` data on the module-level tracker with a different tensor shape, causing the four score-centering cases to fail in the full suite even though their loss calculations are valid.

This addresses the unit-test failure observed in [PR #1840's vLLM CI job](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/actions/runs/41611884661/job/125845856873?pr=1840). Production metric collection and shape validation are unchanged.

## Related Issue

Related to #1840 (CI test failure).

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (not applicable)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_score_centering.py`: 61 passed, 29 skipped on a host without CUDA.
- Repeated the full file with a temporary pytest plugin that seeded a stale `[2, 4]` `n_valid_tokens` entry in the global tracker before the tests: 61 passed, 29 skipped.
- `pre-commit run --files tests/test_score_centering.py` and commit hooks passed. `pre-commit run --all-files` was attempted but stalled for about eight minutes in the large-file hook's `git check-attr filter` subprocess, so it was interrupted. No other file was changed.
- GPU and multi-node suites were not run locally.
